transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I've just been having some trouble at work lately. I do camera work and editing, and... I just keep making these really dumb technical mistakes. 

Stuff I definitely know better than to make. Like, I'll label camera cards wrong, or I'll miss a timecode note. Recently I exported a client cut with the wrong lower-third on it, and the thing is, I had already checked it. It just... it kind of scared me into finally coming in. So, yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you experienced or witnessed any traumatic event recently or in the past that has been bothering you?
No. Um, no, nothing like that. Just the work stuff.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless most days lately?
No. Um... not really. I'm just... annoyed about the work stuff, I guess. But not sad.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies or activities outside of work?
No, not really. I still like my hobbies and stuff. Just... work is the problem.
Have you been feeling more anxious or worried about things lately, even when there isn’t a clear reason?
No. Um, I don't think so. I don't really worry about things like that.
Have you been having any trouble with your memory or concentration lately?

Um... yeah, I guess. That's... well, that's actually what finally scared me into coming in. I just keep making these really dumb technical mistakes. Things I definitely know better than to make. Like... labeling camera cards wrong, or missing a timecode note. I'll even export a client cut with the wrong lower-third, and I swear I already checked it. So... yeah. Concentration, I guess.
How long have you been having trouble with your concentration and memory?

Um... a while, I guess. It got really bad... maybe two years and a couple months ago? That's when the company did this big readjustment thing. It changed how my shoots and edit reviews run, and... yeah. Since then, it's just been a lot harder.
Have you noticed any other changes in your thinking or memory besides concentration problems, like confusion, disorientation, or trouble finding the right words?
No... um, I don't think so. Not really. Just... just what I already said.
When the company made those changes two years ago, did you feel overwhelmed or stressed by how it affected your work, or did you have any difficult experiences related to that transition?
Um... no, not really. I mean... work is work. It was just a new workflow we had to start using. I wouldn't say I was overwhelmed or anything like that. It was just... different.
Do you ever notice these kinds of concentration or memory problems in situations outside of work, like when you're at home or doing things you enjoy?
Um... I don't really know. Not that I've noticed, I guess. It's mostly just... the work stuff. When I'm at home, I don't really notice it being an issue.
Since the workflow changes at work, have you felt any increased frustration, emotional discomfort, or pressure while on the job, even if you didn't consider it overwhelming?
Um... no, I wouldn't say that. I mean, it's just a job. You just... do what you're supposed to do. I don't really get frustrated or... emotional about it, I guess. It's just work.

Have you ever noticed trouble concentrating or remembering things when you're dealing with stress or doing routine tasks outside of work, like managing personal responsibilities or organizing your schedule?
Um... no, not really. I mean, my schedule is pretty straightforward. I just... do what needs to get done. I haven't really noticed any big issues with that stuff.
Have you noticed any changes in your mood or emotions that you feel are out of the ordinary for you, even if they don’t seem directly related to work?
Um... no. I don't think so. Everything's pretty much... the same as always. I haven't really noticed any changes like that.
Have you been sleeping well lately, or have you noticed any changes in your energy level or alertness during the day?
Sleep is fine. I haven't really had any issues with it. My energy is... just normal, I guess. I haven't noticed anything different.
Have you ever had trouble concentrating or remembering things during stressful times in your personal life, even if it wasn't related to work?

Um... I think you might have just asked me something like that. But... no. Like I said, I don't really have issues with my memory or focusing on personal stuff. Even if things are stressful, it's... it's fine. I just handle it.
Have you noticed any subtle changes in how you feel during routine tasks, even if they aren't work-related—like feeling more irritable, tired, or less motivated than usual?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, routine stuff is just... routine. I don't feel any more tired or irritable than I usually would, I guess. It's just the same.
Have you noticed any changes in your relationships or how you interact with others, even if it doesn’t seem related to work?
Um... no. Everything is fine there. I mean, my relationships are just the same as they usually are. I haven't really noticed any changes.
